title: Pain in the ar*e to assemble
text: Pain in the ar*e to assemble. It looks nice a it's sturdy, but for paying $70 it should NOT take 2.5 hours to assemble.  The Allen wrenches are pieces of junk... thankfully I had another tool that worked, but their wrench nearly stripped several screws. I've put together many items far more complicated in less time. From screws just not wanting to go in, to the horrible wrenches and stickers that didn't want to come off, I feel like this - should have been half the cost. It's nice it will do what I needed it to do (provide a perch for my cat in a hard to fill corner), but only buy if you want to struggle through the insanity of trying to get it together.
